extracted text: The paper examines three Al-Zn-Mg-(Sc) alloys: standard AA7075 and two variations with 0.11 wt.% and 0.30 wt.% Sc added. The alloys were cast in air and homogenized at 450°C for 20 h. After extrusion at 350°C with ram speed of 15 mm/s, the bars were solution treated at 480°C for 2 h and aged at 120°C for 24 h. Table 3 shows the tensile properties of the extruded bars after heat treatment, with the 0.30 wt.% Sc alloy exhibiting about 15% higher tensile strength and 25% higher yield strength than ordinary AA7075.
property mapping:
YS [MPa] = Yield strength (MPa) in Table 3
UTS [MPa] = Tensile strength (MPa) in Table 3
elong [%] = Elongation (%) in Table 3
abbreviations:
Sc = Scandium
AA7075 = Aluminum Association designation for the 7075 aluminum alloy
wt.% = weight percentage
